# Personal Writing Style Runtime

> Generic template that applies one person's confirmed private writing-style profile when they are the intended author or speaker.

**What it does.** Not a runnable skill on its own; an install names a specific profile path and person, producing a thin per-person adapter. Does not build or change a profile; that is manage-writing-profile.

**Not for.** Do not apply a personal profile to output written on behalf of another person, to quoted or verbatim material, or where organizational, legal, or contractual voice governs.

**Related.** Depends on [`manage-writing-profile`](_runtime/manage-writing-profile/README.md).
